pages.title: Steam and trees · 1/3
paragraphs: It is nine in the morning at a big national park. Tall green trees stand along a quiet road. Bruno parks his car at the visitor center. Steam rises from the ground far away. A ranger in a green hat waves at him. Her name tag says Kim.
“Welcome to the park! Can I help you?” says Ranger Kim. “Yes. What can we see at the park?” says Bruno. “You can see geysers, lakes and animals.” says Ranger Kim.

pages.title: Steam and trees · 3/3
paragraphs: “Do we need a ticket?” says Bruno. “Yes. It is thirty dollars for each car.” says Ranger Kim. Bruno pays thirty dollars for the car. He takes a map and walks the lake trail. A deer drinks water near a small bridge. Far away, a geyser shoots hot water into the sky. Bruno takes photos but keeps a safe distance. Nature teaches us to look and respect.
